subtests.name: side arrow keys should move between menus in a menubar with multiple menus
side arrow keys should no-op in a menubar with just one menu
side arrow keys should no-op in a menulist invoked by a button
side arrow keys from a menulist or a menubar item with an open submenu should open the submenu of the focused menu
side arrow keys to a menuitem without submenu should close the list and focus without opening
